messages:
rachel: FYI - two customers hit duplicate side-effects from the onboarding sample app when a 429 showed up right as the SDK completed token refresh. both were payment/create endpoints so pretty bad.
bryce: thanks for the heads-up. can you paste a minimal log excerpt? my bet is immediate replay + no idempotency header + zero jitter.
yuna: this pattern keeps popping up. sample app encourages a naive wrapper and teams copy it into prod.
rachel: sanitized trace we got: 
```
2026-04-02T10:43:01Z auth: refresh:start
2026-04-02T10:43:01Z api: 429 rate_limit route=/v1/payments
2026-04-02T10:43:01Z auth: refresh:done
2026-04-02T10:43:01Z client: replaying original request (immediate)
2026-04-02T10:43:01Z api: payment created id=pay_A
2026-04-02T10:43:01Z api: payment created id=pay_B
```
(creates within ~45ms). :grimacing:
flora: immediate mitigation steps: 1) update onboarding/sampleapp to demonstrate Idempotency-Key for write endpoints, 2) add a tiny randomized backoff when replaying after auth refresh (e.g., 10-250ms), 3) SDK option to refuse/flag non-idempotent replay.
bryce: agreed. I propose an SDK config: `replay_protection: 'off'|'warn'|'block'` (default 'warn'). warn = jitter+telemetry, block = deny replay of non-idempotent writes unless Idempotency-Key provided. We should also add `replay_suspect=true` to structured logs when the replay follows a refresh.
yuna: small code example for docs/sampleapp: 
```
// wrapper after refresh
if (tokenWasRefreshed) {
  await sleep(Math.floor(Math.random() * 240) + 10) // 10-250ms jitter
}
headers['Idempotency-Key'] = headers['Idempotency-Key'] || uuidv4()
```
Add a note: "Prefer server-side idempotency if available; jitter reduces collision window for best-effort endpoints."
sre: infra can investigate a best-effort dedupe window (200-300ms) on critical endpoints but can't rely on it universally.
ci-bot: created issue devex/376543 "onboarding dup side-effect - refresh race" with checklist: sampleapp PR, SDK PR, docs update, infra eval.
flora: QA plan: add an e2e that simulates expired token + intermittent 429 on the first attempt, force the refresh path, and assert single side-effect. I'll add this to sampleapp tests.
bryce: telemetry: emit metric `sdk.replays_after_refresh` and tag replays with `replay_protection_mode` and `replay_suspect=true/false`. That will let SRE monitor regressions.
yuna: one UX caveat: streaming endpoints shouldn't get auto-idempotency keys; call that out in docs.
rachel: ok, agreed plan: 1) sampleapp change + e2e test this week, 2) SDK PR for `replay_protection` + jitter + telemetry next week, 3) docs onboarding blurb + troubleshooting note, 4) infra dedupe feasibility check.
bryce: I'll start the SDK PR and include unit tests that simulate the race (mock refresh + 429) and assert behavior across modes.
flora: tagging QA when PRs land so tests can run.
sre: if we see a spike in `sdk.replays_after_refresh` we should alert and prioritize patching customers.
rachel: any objections? :thumbsup:
bryce: :thumbsup:
yuna: :thumbsup:
